purpose: Convert extracted authority into a coding implementation map without creating duplicate engines.
nonNegotiableRule: Every engine writes into or reads from MasterCaseSchema. No engine becomes an independent legal truth store.

canonicalEngineImplementationMap.responsibility: Commencement, service, response deadlines, default risk, default consequences.
Material facts, pleadings, admissions, denials, replies, particulars, amendments, and pleading version control.
duplicationBan: No second issue map outside pleadings.issues
No independent amendment history separate from pleadings.versions

canonicalEngineImplementationMap.responsibility: Document discovery, privilege, continuing disclosure, affidavits of documents, oral discovery, undertakings, refusals, admissions, corrections, and trial use.
duplicationBan: No separate evidence upload brain disconnected from Rule30/31 authority
No separate admissions database outside evidence.admissions

canonicalEngineImplementationMap.responsibility: Motion creation, relief mapping, grounds, jurisdiction, materials, confirmations, abandonment, affidavit evidence, cross-examinations, witness examinations, and discovery evidence on motions.
duplicationBan: No motion checklist separate from motions.records
No affidavit evidence store separate from evidence.motionUse

canonicalEngineImplementationMap.responsibility: Offers, settlement lifecycle, cost consequences, conduct, entitlement to costs, assessment of costs, objections, appeals, registrar fixing, set-off and sheriff costs.
duplicationBan: No isolated offer tracker without cost exposure
No separate costs engine disconnected from conduct and settlement

canonicalEngineImplementationMap.responsibility: Pre-trial conferences, certificate of readiness, expert readiness, witness planning, issue narrowing, settlement authority, documents for trial, pre-trial report, case conferences.
mustPreserve: Existing trial preparation structures if present
duplicationBan: No expert readiness outside evidence/proof/trialReadiness linkage

beforeCoding: Inspect existing evidence, strategy, forms, workflow and dashboard engines.
Confirm existing field names before proposing any replacement.
Only then create full replacement files, never patches.
